description: This source file defines API routes for file ingestion and folder management in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoint handlers for uploading files (parsing and storing structured data), mapping folders for ingestion, and listing all mapped folders, utilizing dependency-injected database connections.

classes.name: FolderMapping
classes.description: Pydantic model representing folder mapping configuration with path and alias.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the response after a file upload, indicating filename and status.

methods.name: upload_file( file: UploadFile = File(...), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, parsing its structured data, storing the upload and parsed content statuses in MongoDB, and cleaning up temporary files.

methods.name: map_folder( mapping: FolderMapping, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Creates or updates a folder mapping record in MongoDB for ingestion.

methods.name: list_mapped_folders( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all monitored folder mappings from MongoDB.

ctags.name: alias
ctags.pattern: /^    alias: str = Field(..., description="Custom name\/label for the folder")$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^    path: str = Field(..., description="Absolute or relative folder path to monitor")$/

ctags.name: upload_file
ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(...), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
